story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date regardless of Assessment Date
Current eligibility change uses Assessment Date when Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: TC_TS002_003 Status field contains "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes preserves relevant field values

flagged.why: negative case expects rejection not in story

gaps: Name: "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 is rejected when Assessment Date changes together with Assessment Tier"

Description: "Validate that the update does not satisfy the Assessment Date-only rule when Assessment Tier changes in the same inbound 834, and confirm the transaction is rejected or not applied as a valid Assessment Date-only transaction effective date update."

Test Step Expected Result: "At least one rejection indicator is visible, such as validation failure, error detail, or lack of successful completed processing for the invalid combined-change transaction."

scenarios.title: Future eligibility change with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date
gaps: Test Step Expected Result field: "The transaction does not satisfy the unchanged-Assessment-Date processing condition for this scenario and shows a failed validation, error, or non-successful outcome for this rule path."
Test Step Expected Result field: "Policy unit delivery is not completed as a successful instance of this scenario, or the transaction is visibly excluded from this rule path in TM."

Test Step Expected Result field: "No new eligibility row is created that reflects this invalid unchanged-Assessment-Date scenario, or the returned eligibility rows do not show this transaction processed under the requested rule path."

Test Step Expected Result field: "No auxiliary span change attributable to the invalid unchanged-Assessment-Date scenario is accepted for this transaction, or no row reflects a successful update from this rejected input."

Test Step Expected Result field: "The file is recorded for audit, but the transaction is rejected, fails validation, or does not process as a valid unchanged-Assessment-Date future eligibility change."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility change with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date

flagged.why: wrong negative outcome for this scenario
edge case never tests an edge outcome

gaps: TC_TS005_002 Name: "Verify AR PASSE update file is rejected when Assessment Date also changes while testing the DTP*303 exception for Aid Category" duplicates a different rule path than the scenario acceptance criteria about unchanged Assessment Date

TC_TS005_002 Description: "Validate that a negative Arkansas PASSE inbound 834 update does not satisfy this scenario when the file changes Aid Category and also changes Assessment Date" is off-topic to the stated scenario that requires unchanged Assessment Date for the tested condition

TC_TS005_003 has no Test Step Expected Result describing an error, rejection, or absent record; for example step 12 Expected Result says "The file is accepted at the transport and parsing level with Disposition Completed and Validation Status Accepted."

scenarios.title: Only specified date sources are used and Maintenance Date is not used outside allowed conditions

flagged.why: one step is conditional and not executable

gaps: TC_TS006_002 step 16 Test Step Description contains conditional execution text: "If SBEL_EFF_DT was updated, compare it to the Assessment Date [TEST DATA: assessment date] and Effective Date [TEST DATA: effective date] from the same file."

scenarios.title: Regression coverage confirms correct date selection across combinations without finance impact
